scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let me take you away to
a distant spiritual place,
a land of exotic mystery,
my hometown Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
让我带你去一个遥远的灵修之地，
一个充满异域神秘色彩的地方，
我的家乡——哎哟泰雅！

scripts.text: About Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 关于哎哟泰雅。

scripts.text: Go to Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 前往哎哟泰雅。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
We Ayothayans are a pious people who value peace and sincerity. We endeavor to lead simple, yet noble, lives in harmony with nature.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我们哎哟泰雅人虔诚而珍视和平与真诚。我们努力过着简单而高贵的生活，与自然和谐共处。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Our traditional cuisine is world famous. It's no surprise when we serve dishes like Tom Yum Goong, made of Shrimp, Lemon and Chillies, which has a tantalizing aroma and flavor beyond imagining.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我们的传统美食闻名世界。当我们端上像泰式BBQ这样的菜肴时，这并不令人惊讶。它由虾、柠檬和辣椒制成，散发着令人难以想象的诱人香气和美味。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
For those who crave adventure, there is an age old story about the Sa-mhing Tiger, an evil creature that haunts our temple ruins.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
对于那些渴望冒险的人来说，有一个古老的故事，关于萨姆辛虎，一种邪恶的生物，它出没在我们的寺庙废墟中。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hahh! Hoo! Hahh!
No man alive can resist the
call of this beautiful land.
Midgardians are
always welcome!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
没有哪个活人能抵挡这片美丽土地的召唤。
米德加德人
永远欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah, you must pay 10,000 Zeny
if you wish to visit Ayothaya.
If you're ready, we can leave
right now~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
啊，如果你想参观哎哟泰雅，需要支付10,000 Zeny。
如果你准备好了，我们现在就可以出发~

scripts.text: I'm ready, let's go!
scripts.translation: 我准备好了，走吧！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let us be off! Back to my
beautiful Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
让我们出发吧！回到我美丽的哎哟泰雅！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
I am sorry, but you do not have the 10,000 Zeny to travel to Ayothaya. Such a price is nothing compared to the experiences that await you!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
很抱歉，你没有足够的10,000 Zeny前往哎哟泰雅。与等待你的体验相比，这个价格微不足道！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Have you ever dreamed
of a beautiful place filled
with spiritual serenity? You
must have been dreaming
of Ayothaya, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
你是否曾梦想过一个充满灵性宁静的地方？你一定是在梦到哎哟泰雅，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hmm! Hah!
So, how did you like Ayothaya? Did you get a chance to try Tom Yum Goong? When you're ready, I shall take you back home.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！嗯！哈！
那么，你觉得哎哟泰雅怎么样？你有机会尝尝泰式BBQ吗？当你准备好时，我会送你回家。

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
You will be welcome to come back whenever you please. I hope that we will see each other again sometime soon. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
欢迎随时回来。希望我们很快能再次相见。谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah yes. I understand that it is difficult to take leave of such a beautiful place. Do not worry
and take your time.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
啊，是的。我理解离开这样一个美丽的地方很难。别担心，慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Thang]
There's an ancient,
dreadful building in
Ayothaya that no one
here dares approach...
scripts.translation:
[唐]
哎哟泰雅有一座古老而可怕的建筑物，这里没人敢靠近...

scripts.text:
[Thang]
In the past, a few curious people went inside, despite the horror stories, and never returned. What on earth could be going on inside of that place?
scripts.translation:
[唐]
过去，有几个好奇的人不顾恐怖故事进去了，再也没有回来。那个地方到底发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Thang]
However, if you want to prove your courage to others, confronting the danger inside might be a worthy challenge for an adventurer...
I think.
scripts.translation:
[唐]
不过，如果你想向别人证明你的勇气，面对里面的危险可能是一个值得冒险的挑战...
我想。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hello!
I don't think
we've met before.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你好！
我想我们
以前没见过吧。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You must be
from Midgard.
After all, I know every single person living in this village.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你一定是
来自米德加尔特的人。
毕竟，这个村庄里的每一个人
我全都认识。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...
May I ask about the land you
come from? I'm curious about
a lot of things in the outside world.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...
我可以问问你
来自哪里吗？
我对外面的世界
有很多好奇的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You know, like the dresses and jewelry that ladies wear in other countries, whether or not the men are good looking, what kind of songs you have, what kind of girls that guys over there like...
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
比如，其他国家的女士们
穿什么样的衣服、戴什么样的首饰，
那里的男士们帅不帅，
你们那里流行什么样的歌曲，
还有那边的男生喜欢什么样的女孩...

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Okay~!
Take care and
enjoy your travels!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
好~！
保重，
旅途愉快！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
When you go East from this
village, you will arrive at the ruins of an old shrine. It is now
a nest full of fearsome monsters.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
从这个村庄往东走，
你会到达一座古老神龛的废墟。
那里现在
成了充满可怕魔物的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
If you plan to venture through these ruins, you better prepare
as much as you can!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
如果你打算
穿越这片废墟，
最好尽可能做好充分准备！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Ah...
I wonder where
my Black Knight is~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
啊...
不知道我的
黑骑士在哪里~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you mean...
Knight in shining armor
riding a white horse?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你该不会是指...
骑着白马、
身穿闪亮铠甲的骑士吧？

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...?
Oh, well...
I'll take them both!
Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...？
哦，好吧...
两个我都要！
嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Mmm...?
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...？
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Ummm.
Hmmmmm...
Ummmmm...?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
唔。
嗯嗯...
唔唔...？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
You must be
an outsider.
Yes. Yes, indeed.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你一定是
外乡人。
是的，没错。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Did you just ask
where am I going?
Why, to the Fishing Spot
just ahead. That's what
we old men do: fish.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你刚才问
我要去哪里吗？
当然是去前面的
钓鱼点了。我们老人家
就是干这个的：钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Hmmm...
Would you like to hear
something interesting? I've heard that someone found a ring inside
a fish he caught in the
Fishing Spot.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
嗯...
想听点有趣的事吗？
我听说有人
在钓鱼点钓上来的鱼肚子里
发现了一枚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Supposedly, there are lots of stories about people finding valuables inside of the fish they've been catching there.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
据说，有很多关于人们
在钓鱼点钓到的鱼肚子里
发现贵重物品的故事。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're lucky enough,
you might even become
a millionaire.
Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[村民]
如果你运气够好，
说不定还能
成为百万富翁呢。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...!?
Ah, I came into the fish market! ^666666*Sigh*^000000 It seems I went the wrong way. The Fishing Spot is on the opposite side of this village.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
...！？
啊，我走到鱼市来了！^666666*叹气*^000000 看来我走错方向了。钓鱼点在这个村庄的另一边。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Since I'm here, it wouldn't be
a bad idea to look around. All of the seafood in this market is fresh and tasty. You'll regret it if you don't try some of this seafood
at least once.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
既然都来了，四处逛逛也不错。这里市场里的海鲜都很新鲜美味。如果你不尝尝这些海鲜，至少一次，你会后悔的。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Phew, isn't it
soooo hot today?
scripts.translation:
[关]
呼，今天可真热啊？

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You must be
from Midgard, huh?
I've seen a lot of tourists
coming from there recently.
scripts.translation:
[关]
你一定是从米德加尔特来的吧？
最近我见过很多从那里来的游客。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You'd better be really careful if you travel outside of the village. Whatever you do, don't go into
the ruins of an old shrine
in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[关]
如果你要在村庄外旅行，最好格外小心。无论如何，都不要进入森林中那座古老神龛的废墟。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
That place is far too
dangerous to visit. Still, I hear that if you had some kind of amulet, you could go there with
a little less worry...
scripts.translation:
[关]
那个地方太危险了，不适合去。不过我听说，如果你有一些护身符，去那里时就能少一些担忧...

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Well, anyway, it's still a really good idea to stay away from that place. I hope you enjoy visiting Ayothaya, and that you keep safe~
scripts.translation:
[关]
总之，还是最好远离那个地方。希望你能在哎哟泰雅玩得开心，并且注意安全~

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
In Ayothaya, we have our own traditional martial arts. We, the young men of the village, practice our traditional martial arts in order to become strong.
scripts.translation:
[德齐]
在哎哟泰雅，我们有自己的传统武术。我们村里的年轻男子练习传统武术，是为了变得更强。

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
Why don't you learn our martial arts? I guarantee that it will help you greatly in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[德齐]
为什么不学学我们的武术呢？我保证，这对你的旅行会有很大帮助。

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Hey...
You look pretty strong
You wanna challenge
me to a match?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
嘿...
你看起来挺强的。
想跟我比试一场吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: Nah~
scripts.translation: 不了~

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Ow ow ow!
I was just
kidding, man!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
哎哟哎哟！
我开玩笑的，兄弟！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
I'm not so rude as to pick fights with strangers for no reason!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
我可没那么粗鲁，无缘无故找陌生人打架！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Real power is developed after having thousands of matches with other people. So, don't be afraid of fighting, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
真正的力量是在与成千上万的人交手后磨练出来的。所以，不要害怕战斗，好吗？
